name: Ketamine
tierNotes: Threshold: near-clean — the faintest softness only.

Light: still very close to clean; only acuity/desat/coolCast are perceptibly non-zero. The shared breathing/drift/flowWarp trio is on the 'late' curve, so barely present — enough that the render is never a dead static filter. No black surround; the frame is fully rectangular.

Common: reads mostly sharp — flatten's onset is pushed later and acuity/dof are on the late curve. In their place a modest colourful touch: the dissolve pattern (flat/posterized but colour-shifted from the photo's palette) onsets here, so surfaces show the first hint of colour-patterning without losing the photo. breathing/drift/flowWarp are clearly perceptible but well short of their ceiling; world recession hasn't woken up, so there's no black surround.

Strong: only a small black margin — recession and the k-hole surround use a sudden two-part curve, so the black stays modest and a discrete k-hole is reserved for Heavy. What carries Strong is colourful content: environmental cubism/scenery-slicing (PW's 'algorithmic/synthetic/low-complexity' ketamine geometry) across 11 facets with hard posterize banding, plus the dissolve pattern-crawl (well past halfway now) woven through much of the photo; flatten/acuity/dof arrive here, and breathing/drift/flowWarp are well past halfway, so the whole frame is visibly alive.

Heavy: the k-hole arrives suddenly in the last stretch — recession and surround darkening spike hard between Strong and here, so the final few percent feel like a trapdoor. Cubism at its ceiling with starker posterize; the receded painting crawls/breathes via a 2D domain-warp, its colour giving way to the continuous texture/luminance-masked pattern (now full strength) with a thin ink-like band-edge contour — flat, posterized, desaturated-cool, tinted from the photo's palette. Structure-driven like the psychedelics but staying in ketamine's 'algorithmic'/low-complexity register, never LSD/DMT's rainbow or fractal tiling.
